core.title: 3/4 Inch Thick Door Invisible Door Hinges, SOSS 204
tags: 3/4 Inch Thick Door Invisible Door Hinges

text.description_html:
SOSS 204, Invisible Door Hinges

SOSS 204 hinges are for use on 3/4" thick wood doors. Package includes one (1) hinge with matching finish #8 x 1-1/4" wood screws. When the door is closed, SOSS Invisible Hinges cannot be seen or tampered with. When opened, the riveted hinge pin is non-removable. The installed hinge is firmly anchored in a deep, full mortise, which assists the screws in supporting the door, assuring a stronger door hinge installation.

Also Available For 1-3/4" Thick Doors SOSS 218 Hinge, 1-3/8" Thick Doors SOSS 216 Hinge, and 2" Thick Doors SOSS 220 Hinge

Features and Specifications of the Invisible Door Hinge:

  • Total Height: 2-3/8"
  • Leaf Plate Width: 1/2"
  • Total Width: 1-23/64"
  • Door Thickness: 3/4" Thick Door
  • Wood Screws: #8 x 1-1/4"
  • Hinge Material: High Strength Steel

*Sold in Pair (2 Door Hinges)
